purpose: Verification of Cloudflare limits for the Phase 4.36 Surface Intelligence design (budget: 6 requests; used 4). Fetched through the WebFetch tool, which summarises the page with a small model: figures are VERIFIED as 'read from the official page via summarised fetch on 2026-11-14' and are cross-checked against the repo's own Phase 4.33 report where possible.

requests.result: Free: CPU 10 ms/request; memory 128 MB/isolate; 50 external subrequests, 1,000 internal; Worker size 64 MiB uncompressed ('There is no compressed size limit. Only the uncompressed bundle size counts'); 100 Workers; startup 1 s; 6 simultaneous connections; 100,000 requests/day; static assets 20,000 files/version, 25 MiB per file. Paid: CPU 5 min (30 s default), 10,000 subrequests.

Free: 10 databases; 500 MB/database; 5 GB/account; 50 queries per Worker invocation (a db.batch() counts as one query); 100 bound parameters/query; 100 KB SQL statement; 30 s query; 2 MB row/string/BLOB; 50 MB result (from 2026-11-04). Paid: 1,000 queries/invocation, 10 GB/database.
Free: 5 million rows read/day, 100,000 rows written/day, 5 GB storage; resets 00:00 UTC. Paid: 25 billion rows read and 50 million rows written per month included.
Static asset requests are free and unlimited (not billed as Worker requests); no CPU statement on the page; numeric file limits are on the Workers limits page (request 1).
